note.title: Free-time activities
note.specFocus: hobbies, music, sport, entertainment and leisure preferences
note.sourcePages: Original practice material written around common GCSE-style language themes; not official exam-board material.
note.summary:
2.1 Free-time activities
Key focus
- hobbies, music, sport, entertainment and leisure preferences.

Core language
- Useful structures: secondo me; penso che; mi piace perché; l’anno scorso; in futuro; di solito; dovrei/dovremmo.
- Use verbs of liking, frequency adverbs and justified opinions; narrate past events in a clear sequence.

Exam tips
- For comprehension, locate the exact word or phrase that proves each answer.
- In translation, preserve tense, negatives, quantities and relationships between people.
- In writing, add opinions and reasons, vary time frames, and check verb and adjective agreement.

questions.examTip: Keep nouns and adjectives in agreement, use the correct article, and preserve the tense of each English sentence.

Translate into Italian:

questions.examTip: Keep nouns and adjectives in agreement, use the correct article, and preserve the tense of each English sentence.
questions.modelAnswer: Quest’estate imparerò a fare surf e visiterò il mare ogni mattina.
questions.question:
Translate into Italian:

This summer I will learn to surf and go to the sea every morning.

questions.examTip: Cover every bullet, use a past and a future reference where relevant, and support each opinion with perché.
questions.modelAnswer:
Nel tempo libero suono la chitarra in un piccolo gruppo. Il sabato gioco a pallavolo al centro sportivo con le mie amiche. Preferisco i film divertenti perché mi fanno dimenticare la scuola. Secondo me è importante e vorrei provare un’esperienza diversa in futuro.

(English translation: In my free time I play the guitar in a small band. On Saturdays I play volleyball at the sports centre with my friends. I prefer funny films because they make me forget about school. In my opinion it is important, and I would like to try a different experience in the future.)
questions.question:
Write 40–60 words in Italian about free-time activities (hobbies, music, sport, entertainment and leisure preferences). You must mention:
• the main person or activity
• your current opinion
• a recent or typical experience
• what you plan for the future

questions.examTip: Cover every bullet, use a past and a future reference where relevant, and support each opinion with perché.
questions.modelAnswer:
Il sabato gioco a pallavolo al centro sportivo con le mie amiche. Preferisco i film divertenti perché mi fanno dimenticare la scuola. Sabato scorso abbiamo visto un concerto, ma i biglietti erano cari. Secondo me è importante e vorrei provare un’esperienza diversa in futuro.

(English translation: On Saturdays I play volleyball at the sports centre with my friends. I prefer funny films because they make me forget about school. Last Saturday we saw a concert, but the tickets were expensive. In my opinion it is important, and I would like to try a different experience in the future.)

• something that happened in the past
• your view and a reason

questions.examTip: Cover every bullet, use a past and a future reference where relevant, and support each opinion with perché.

(English translation: I prefer funny films because they make me forget about school. Last Saturday we saw a concert, but the tickets were expensive. I hardly ever watch television during the week. In my opinion it is important, and I would like to try a different experience in the future.)
